Implement the first ProjectWeave runtime using GitHub Projects v2 as canonical project state. A CLI Run loads and selects an eligible Issue, routes execution using explicit resource availability, invokes a replaceable executor, and writes structured results back to GitHub.

## Outcome

- Small graph model: agent/action nodes, ordered data handoff, conditional routing, bounded execution, and separate Runtime Failures.
- Resource admission and reservation/reported accounting, with executor-dependent in-flight enforcement explicitly documented.
- Paginated GitHub reads, ready-label eligibility, Priority/oldest-Issue selection, result comments and optional Status updates.
- Public GitWeave CLI adapter and a common JSON command-executor boundary, plus design documentation and runnable configurable examples.
- No daemon, custom task database, general plugin framework, or loop/parallel/map runtime features.
